# PsychosisScalingPhenotype

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A characteristic pattern of altered scaling behavior observed in early psychosis, reflecting disrupted critical dynamics in neural circuits. Serves as a biological marker that can inspire neuromorphic models of cognitive disorders and guide the development of brain-inspired computing for mental health diagnostics.
